houdini_version_notes: SOP-side prep feeding a Solaris Instancer LOP; USD point instancing reads orient, pscale and an index.
title: Point-Instancer Transform Attributes for USD
prompt: Author per-point orient, scale and variant index for a USD instancer
explanation: The USD point instancer needs an orientation, a scale and a prototype index per point. Authoring them on the SOP side before importing to Solaris is the most controllable path -- you get full VEX expressivity, then LOPs just consume the attributes.

houdini_version_notes: Cd on SOP geometry is imported as primvars:displayColor in USD.
title: Author USD displayColor via Cd
prompt: Set a height-based colour that becomes USD displayColor
explanation: Houdini maps the Cd point attribute to USD's displayColor primvar on import, so authoring Cd in a wrangle is the simplest way to give Solaris geometry viewport/preview colour without building a material.

houdini_version_notes: The 'name' / 'path' attribute drives USD prim paths on import.
title: Stable USD Prim Names
prompt: Generate stable USD prim paths from a piece attribute
explanation: USD relies on stable prim paths; deriving s@name from a persistent piece id (rather than primitive number) keeps paths constant even when topology order changes, which protects downstream references and layer overrides.

houdini_version_notes: usdpurpose attribute maps to the USD 'purpose' on import.
title: Tag USD Purpose (proxy/render)
prompt: Split geometry into proxy and render purposes for USD
explanation: USD's 'purpose' lets a prim carry both a cheap proxy and a heavy render representation. Authoring usdpurpose in a wrangle on the SOP side cleanly partitions geometry before it ever reaches Solaris.
